select point_event_key , point_event_name , point_accu_type , case when point_accu_type='1' then '일반' when point_accu_type ='2' then '수기지급' else '미정의' end as point_accu_type_name , expire_days , max_unit_point from point_event_mst order by point_event_key

mapper.update: update point_event_mst set expire_days = ifnull(#{expireDays},expire_days) , max_unit_point = ifnull(#{maxUnitPoint},max_unit_point) where point_event_key = #{pointEventKey}
